summary: Spark Core 2.0 - UserAvatar centralisation + bots-no-wallet. ALL 11 acceptance tests PASS (2 backend + 9 frontend). Avatars rendered as real images for users with avatar set (Willem, Madelief, Harry, Smith, Roadkill, De Boekhouder). Roadkill grayscale fallback rendered for all 7 users without avatar (Spark, Heidi, Marieke, Ron, Nick, joel123, piet). Wallet & Tokens card correctly HIDDEN for all bot-* users (verified Harry) and VISIBLE for Spark (user-000, per clarification) and Marieke. Sidebar bottom Willem shows Black Knight image. Privé tab contacts all show avatars; Heidi header shows Roadkill fallback. Community tab bot+own avatars render correctly (verified visually in screenshot).

Backend Test 11: For temp grad-5 non-admin viewer, admin contacts grouped to single 'Admin' entry with avatar_ref=null (no leak); bots retain gallery refs; admin-collectief not visible

Frontend Test 2: Harry selection — avatar-bot-harry img count = 2 (list row + detail panel large avatar), no -letter testid present
Frontend Test 3: Harry selection — wallet-tokens-card count = 0 (correctly hidden for bot)

Frontend Test 4: Spark (user-000) — badge-spark count = 1 (SPARK CORE badge present), wallet-tokens-card count = 1 (visible with admin notice 'tokens beheren via Spark treasury (user-000) niet via UI.') — matches CLARIFICATION
Frontend Test 5: Marieke (user-c609d7d1) — wallet-tokens-card count = 1 (visible, not a bot)
Frontend Test 6: Sidebar bottom avatar-user-001 contains , no -letter variant present
Frontend Test 7: Privé tab — all 4 bot contacts + Roadkill render avatar-{uid} with child (confirmed: bot-boekhouder, bot-madelief, bot-harry, bot-smith, user-1996fa59)
Frontend Test 8: Heidi selection in Privé — header avatar-user-64bf063d img count = 2 with src=roadkill-logo + grayscale; no -letter variant

Frontend Test 9: Community tab — own avatar-user-001 img present; bot message avatars visually verified as real face images in screenshot (Madelief/Harry/Smith faces in bubbles + 'Bots Online' sidebar)
critical_code_review_comments: Pre-existing (carried from iter 15, non-blocking): React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' inside UsersAdminPage gradatie <select> dropdown. Cosmetic console noise only.

Test 11 spec used Marieke (user-c609d7d1, gradatie 3) as 'non-admin viewer' but contacts module treats gradatie ≤ 3 as admin tier. Adjusted test to create a temp gradatie-5 user (cleaned up after). Worth noting in spec: Marieke IS admin tier per contacts/list logic, so admin avatars correctly DO show to her with real names — no leak occurs because she's a designated helpdesk admin.

CommunityBubble likely renders avatars via UserAvatar but data-testid not propagated per-message (a single bot may produce N messages → N identical testids). Not a bug, just makes per-message testid counting unreliable. Already visually verified, no action needed.
UserAvatar component is clean (90 lines, well-documented). Final letter fallback only triggered on img onError, which is the correct progressive enhancement strategy.
seed_data_creation: Backend Test 11 created a temp user (naam=TEST_NonAdmin, gradatie=5) and DELETEd it in the same test's finally block. State restored to baseline after run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UserAvatar component at /app/frontend/src/components/common/UserAvatar.js renders 4 modes: image (gallery:/user/upload), emoji, fallback (roadkill grayscale), letter (only on img error). data-testid='avatar-{user.id}' for image/emoji/fallback; 'avatar-{id}-letter' for final fallback. Wallet card hidden when id startsWith('bot-') OR type==='bot' — Spark (user-000) NOT affected (per design). Backend contacts /list now exposes 'avatar_ref' field; null for anonymized admin contacts (gradatie ≥ 4 viewers only); 'emoji:🛡️' for admin-collectief. Marieke (gradatie 3) is admin tier for contacts module, NOT a true non-admin — to test anonymization create grad ≥ 4 user.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. All acceptance criteria met.
